finding.title: Move test/features/auth/** to mirror lib/features/account/** (orphaned test directory)
finding.why: There is no lib/features/auth/ anywhere in the repo (confirmed via `find lib/features -maxdepth 1`) — every subject under test lives in lib/features/account/** or lib/core/auth/**. A contributor grepping test/features/account/ for existing auth coverage (the layout every other feature follows) won't find these 8 files and has no signal they exist; that is exactly how the pending_local_signup.dart suite ended up duplicated twice inside this same orphaned directory instead of being caught in review (see companion finding).
finding.recommendation: git mv the whole tree to test/features/account/**, one-to-one with the lib path each file's own imports already point at (auth_state_test.dart -> domain/models/, sign_in_screen_test.dart -> presentation/screens/, local_auth_service_test.dart/auth_exceptions_test.dart/pending_local_*_test.dart -> domain/services/), drop the now-redundant .gitkeep, and check for any CI/coverage globs pinned to the old path.
acceptance_criteria: test/features/auth/ no longer exists; each moved file lives at the path mirroring its subject's lib/ location
dart test (or the relevant make test-epic-* targets) is green after the move with no import breakage
the [Pending] AG-5 mirroring checker, once it lands, passes for this slice

evidence.quote: test('returns null when accountId is missing', () {
test('tryParse returns null when required fields are missing', () {

finding.title: sign_in_screen_test.dart never exercises the registry-mode / forgot-password logic on this churn-hotspot screen
finding.why: Every test in this file only varies the connectivity stream (true/false/empty) and reads static widget output; grepping the whole test/ tree for RegistryMatchKind returns zero hits anywhere in the repo, so the debounced device-registry lookup (Epic 21.7: _onEmailChanged/_effectiveSignInMode/_registrySubtitle) that decides which mode card and hint text a returning user sees is completely unverified. The file also never calls tester.enterText or tester.tap, so the documented SI-WP-01 regression (error snackbar silently dropped because the show-error callback was wired inside a postFrameCallback) and the AN-11 forgot-password flow (deliberately shows the same snackbar on success and failure to avoid email enumeration) have no regression test — the next edit to this hotspot can reintroduce either bug with nothing to catch it.
finding.recommendation: Add widget tests that enter an email to trigger the 300ms registry debounce and assert the rendered mode card/hint for at least localBorn, cloudBorn, and notOnDevice x online/offline; add an interaction test that submits sign-in and asserts the error snackbar appears (locks in SI-WP-01); add a forgot-password test asserting identical snackbar copy on a resolving vs. throwing authRepositoryProvider override.
acceptance_criteria: New tests fail against a reverted _effectiveSignInMode (or a reverted SI-WP-01 initState fix) and pass against current code
RegistryMatchKind (or its rendered effect) is asserted by at least one test in this file
A forgot-password test exists asserting identical success/failure snackbar text

finding.title: auth_integration_test.dart is fully subsumed by auth_repository_impl_test.dart

evidence.quote: class MockFirebaseAuthGateway extends Mock implements FirebaseAuthGateway {}
class MockFirebaseAuthGateway extends Mock implements FirebaseAuthGateway {}

finding.why: auth_integration_test.dart's single 'end-to-end' test (sign in with email then sign out, asserting the mapped AppUser stream) re-derives, near line-for-line, the same mock setup as auth_repository_impl_test.dart and re-covers ground already split across that file's signInWithEmail/signOut/onAuthStateChanged groups. Both files mock the exact same two gateways with no other collaborator wired in, so this isn't really an integration test — it's a second, smaller unit-test file for the same class, adding no scenario the 536-line sibling doesn't already cover.
finding.recommendation: Delete auth_integration_test.dart; if the multi-step subscribe-then-signIn-then-signOut stream sequencing is considered a distinct scenario worth keeping, fold it into auth_repository_impl_test.dart's onAuthStateChanged group instead of maintaining a separate file.
acceptance_criteria: auth_integration_test.dart removed (or its unique scenario merged) with no loss of asserted behavior
